we have successfully prepared and characterized the self-patterning of porous films of giant POM vesicles, which are highly ordered honeycombs, and the films have hydrophobic surface.
the self-patterning of giant vesicles into highly ordered honeycomb porous films on solid surfaces is firstly studied in detail.
the giant vesicle of {Mo72}Fe30}(DODO)3 complexes can self-patterned into highly ordered honeycomb frameworks on the solid surface, which is the first report of this kind of vesicle materials.

the preparation of porous films by using the self-assembled vesicles of {FeMoO} clusters, and the properties of the films.
the preparation of self-patterming porous films consisting of POM vesicles and its properties.

the self-patterning of the porous films of giant POM vesicles is a novel and simple way to construct porous films of giant molecular vesicles, which is a promising method for the construction of functional porous films.
the giant vesicles are a promising material for the preparation of porous films, which may be applied to many fields.
